name: NoAdditionalTermBondRefs
description: Number of bonds in the repeating group.

name: AdditionalTermBondSecurityID
description: Security identifier of the bond.

name: AdditionalTermBondSecurityIDSource
description: Identifies the source scheme of the AdditionalTermBondSecurityID(40001) value.

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: AdditionalTermBondDesc
description: Description of the bond.

name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondDescLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAdditionalTermBondDesc(40005) field.

name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondDesc
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AdditionalTermBondDesc(40003) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AdditionalTermBondDesc(40003) field.

name: AdditionalTermBondCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the bond value is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: AdditionalTermBondIssuer
description: Issuer of the bond.

name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuer(40009) field.

name: EncodedAdditionalTermBondIssuer
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the AdditionalTermBondIssuer(40007) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the AdditionalTermBondIssuer(40007) field.

name: AdditionalTermBondSeniority
description: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

name: AdditionalTermBondCouponType
description: Coupon type of the bond.

name: AdditionalTermBondCouponRate
description: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

name: AdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
description: The maturity date of the bond.

name: AdditionalTermBondParValue
description: The par value of the bond.

name: AdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
description: Total issued amount of the bond.

name: AdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: AdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

name: AdditionalTermBondDayCount
description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

name: NoAdditionalTerms
description: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

name: AdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
description: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

name: AdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
description: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

name: NoCashSettlTerms
description: Number of elements in the repeating group.

name: CashSettlCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlAmount(40034) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: CashSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
description: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for the purpose of cash settlement.

name: CashSettlValuationTime
description: The time of valuation.

name: CashSettlBusinessCenter
description: Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: CashSettlQuoteMethod
description: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

name: CashSettlQuoteAmount
description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.

name: CashSettlQuoteCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlQuoteAmount(40028) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

name: CashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.

name: CashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the CashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount(40030) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

name: CashSettlDealer
description: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.

name: CashSettlBusinessDays
description: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.

name: CashSettlAmount
description: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.

name: CashSettlRecoveryFactor
description: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount calculated is (1 - CashSettlRecoveryFactor(40035)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

name: CashSettlFixedTermIndicator
description: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

name: CashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
description: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in CashSettlAmount(40034). For cash settlement this specifies whether quotations should be obtained inclusive or not of accrued interest.

name: CashSettlValuationMethod
description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

name: CashSettlTermXID
description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

name: NoContractualDefinitions
description: Number of financing definitions in the repeating group.

name: ContractualDefinition
description: Specifies which contract definition, such as those published by ISDA, will apply for the terms of the trade. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-definitions for values.

name: NoContractualMatrices
description: Number of contractual matrices in the repeating group.

name: ContractualMatrixSource
description: Identifies the applicable contract matrix. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/matrix-type-1-0.xml for values.

name: ContractualMatrixDate
description: The publication date of the applicable version of the contract matrix. If not specified, the ISDA Standard Terms Supplement defines rules for which version of the matrix is applicable.

name: ContractualMatrixTerm
description:
Specifies the applicable key into the relevant contract matrix. In the case of 2000 ISDA Definitions Settlement Matrix for Early Termination and Swaptions, the ContractualMatrixTerm(40045) is not applicable and is to be omitted.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/credit-matrix-transaction-type for values.

name: NoFinancingTermSupplements
description: Number of financing terms supplements in the repeating group.

name: FinancingTermSupplementDesc
description: Identifies the applicable contractual supplement. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/contractual-supplement for values.

name: FinancingTermSupplementDate
description: The publication date of the applicable version of the contractual supplement.

name: NoStreams
description: Number of swap streams in the repeating group.

name: StreamType
description: Type of swap stream.

name: StreamDesc
description: A short descriptive name given to the payment stream. Eg. CDS, Fixed, Float, Float2, GBP. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as reference.

name: StreamPaySide
description: The side of the party paying the stream.

name: StreamReceiveSide
description: The side of the party receiving the stream.

name: StreamNotional
description: Notional, or initial notional value for the payment stream. Use the PaymentScheduleGrp component to specify the rate steps.

name: StreamCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the StreamNotional(40054) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: StreamText
description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted effective date.

name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's effective, or relative effective, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the underlying instrument's stream's effective, or relative effective, date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the effective date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative effective date offset.

name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative effective date offset.

name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative effective date offset.

name: UnderlyingStreamEffectiveDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted effective date.

name: StreamTerminationDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted termination date.

name: StreamTerminationDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: StreamTerminationDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's stream's termination, or relative termination, date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: StreamTerminationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the termination date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative termination date offset.

name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative termination date offset.

name: StreamTerminationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative termination date offset.

name: StreamTerminationDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted termination date.

name: StreamCalculationPeriodBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust calculation periods. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: StreamCalculationPeriodBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust calculation periods, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first calculation period start date if before the effective date.

name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's stream's first calculation period start date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's stream's first calculation period start date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: StreamFirstPeriodStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted first calculation period start date, if it is before the effective date.

name: StreamFirstRegularPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first start date of the regular calculation period, if there is an initial stub period.

name: StreamFirstCompoundingPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted end date of the initial compounding period.

name: StreamLastRegularPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted last regular period end date if there is a final stub period.

name: StreamCalculationFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

name: StreamCalculationFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which calculation period end dates occur.

name: StreamCalculationRollConvention
description: The convention for determining the sequence of end dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

name: NoSettlRateFallbacks
description: Number of settlement rate fallbacks in the repeating group

name: SettlRatePostponementMaximumDays
description: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceding to this method.

name: LegPaymentStreamNonDeliverableSettlRateSource
description: Identifies the source of the rate information.

name: SettlRatePostponementSurvey
description: Indicates whether to request a settlement rate quote from the market.

name: SettlRatePostponementCalculationAgent
description: Used to identify the settlement rate postponement calculation agent.

values.meaning: As specified in the master agreement
As specified in the standard terms supplement

name: NoProvisions
description: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

name: ProvisionType
description: Type of provisions.

name: ProvisionDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

name: ProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: ProvisionDateBusinessCenter
description: The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's dates, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted date of the provision.

name: ProvisionDateTenorPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

name: ProvisionDateTenorUnit
description: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

name: ProvisionCalculationAgent
description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in ProvisionCalculationAgent(40098) or in the ProvisionParties component.

values.meaning: As specified in the master agreement
As specified in the standard terms supplement

name: ProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

name: ProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStyle
description: The instrument provision option’s exercise style.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

name: ProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

name: ProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

name: ProvisionCashSettlMethod
description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

name: ProvisionCashSettlCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: ProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteType
description: Identifies the type of quote to be used.

name: ProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
description: Identifies the source of quote information.

name: ProvisionText
description: Free form text to specify additional information or enumeration description when a standard value does not apply.

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueTime
description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
description: Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The cash settlement valuation date adjustment business day convention. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessCenter
description: The business center calendar used to adjust the provision's cash settlement valuation date, e.g. "GBLO". See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

name: ProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option exercise date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

name: ProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
description: Number of provision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
description: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(40144).

name: ProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option expiration date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationTime
description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

name: ProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the instrument's provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the instrument's provision's option underlying date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

name: ProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination or relative termination date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination or relative termination date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
description: First date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
description: The last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

name: NoProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
description: Number of provision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(40173).

name: ProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: NoProvisionPartyIDs

name: ProvisionPartyID
description: The party identifier/code for the payment settlement party.

name: ProvisionPartyIDSource
description: Identifies class or source of the ProvisionPartyID(40175) value.

description: The type of ProvisionPartySubID(40179).

name: NoProtectionTerms
description: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

name: ProtectionTermNotional
description: The notional amount of protection coverage.

name: ProtectionTermCurrency
description: The currency of ProtectionTermNotional(40182). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: ProtectionTermSellerNotifies
description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

name: ProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

name: ProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter

description: Specifies the currency in which LegPaymentStreamFixedAmount(40327) or LegPaymentStreamRate(40326) is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

description: The future value notional is normally only required for certain non-deliverable interest rate swaps (e.g. Brazillian Real (BRL) vs. CETIP Interbank Deposit Rate (CDI)). The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency is the same as the stream notional.

name: LegPaymentStreamFutureValueDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted value date of the future value amount.

description: The payment stream floating rate index.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexSource
description: The source of the payment stream floating rate index.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexCurveUnit
description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's floating rate index curve period.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexCurvePeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's floating rate index curve period.

description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpread
description: The basis points spread from the index specified in LegPaymentStreamRateIndex(40331).

name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadPositionType
description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateTreatment
description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

name: LegPaymentStreamCapRate
description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

name: LegPaymentStreamCapRateBuySide
description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

name: LegPaymentStreamCapRateSellSide
description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRate
description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRateBuySide
description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

name: LegPaymentStreamFloorRateSellSide
description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

name: LegPaymentStreamInitialRate
description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRateRoundingDirection
description: Specifies the rounding direction.

name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRatePrecision
description: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

name: LegPaymentStreamAveragingMethod
description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

name: LegPaymentStreamNegativeRateTreatment
description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the inflation lag period. The lag period is the offsetting period from the payment date which determineds the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagUnit
description: Time unit associated with the inflation lag period.

name: LegPaymentStreamInflationLagDayType
description: The inflation lag period day type.

name: LegPaymentStreamInflationInterpolationMethod
description: The method used when calculating the inflation index level from multiple points. The most common is linear method.

name: LegPaymentStreamInflationIndexSource
description: The inflation index reference source.

name: LegPaymentStreamInflationPublicationSource

name: LegPaymentStreamInflationInitialIndexLevel
description: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.
